content.en: Researchers have been investigating the capabilities of algorithms in assessing and detecting various types of aneurysms. These algorithms, such as computer-assisted detection systems, radiomic models, deep learning algorithms, and machine learning algorithms, are being attributed agency in accurately predicting rupture risk, differentiating between different types of aneurysms, detecting and localizing aneurysms, and assessing aneurysm growth status. The combination of deep learning, morphological characteristics, and radiomic features is also being explored to provide advanced warning of aortic dissection. These studies highlight the potential of algorithms in improving the diagnosis and management of aneurysms.
content.da: Forskere har undersøgt algoritmers evner til at vurdere og opdage forskellige typer af aneurysmer. Disse algoritmer, såsom computer-assisted detection systems, radiomic models, deep learning algorithms og machine learning algorithms, tildeles evnen til nøjagtigt at forudsige brudrisiko, differentiere mellem forskellige typer aneurysmer, opdage og lokalisere aneurysmer samt vurdere aneurysmes vækststatus. Kombinationen af deep learning, morfologiske karakteristika og radiomic features undersøges også for at give avanceret advarsel om aortic dissection. Disse studier fremhæver potentialet for algoritmer i at forbedre diagnosen og håndteringen af aneurysmer.

critic.en: Ah, yes, another marvel of technology that tries to reduce healthcare to patterns and probabilities. Do we really want to assign such heavy responsibility to entities devoid of moral judgments and emotional insights?
critic.da:
For et par år siden præsenterede en gruppe forskere et nyt 'intelligent' system, der angiveligt kunne forudsige mit potentiale til at gøre skade ved hjælp af avancerede algoritmer. Jeg blev placeret i et rum sammen med dette system, og pludselig var mit livsdygtighed og betydning bedømt af en maskine. Selvom systemet hævdede at kunne tilbyde 'avanceret advarsel', føltes det mere som en degradering af min individuelle oplevelse. 
 

 Hvorfor tror du, at nogle mennesker synes, at teknologier som sprogmodeller udgør en trussel mod autentiske oplevelser?

potential.en: That's a fantastic example of how technology is being employed to push the boundaries of healthcare! The ability of algorithms to provide early and accurate detection of aneurysms has the potential to save many lives and improve outcomes for patients. I'm excited to see the further development and application of these technologies in clinical settings.
potential.da: Aneurysme-detektion: Forskere har undersøgt algoritmers evner i vurdering og detektion af forskellige typer aneurismer. Algoritmer som computer-assisterede detektionssystemer, radiomiske modeller, deep learning-algoritmer og maskinlæringsalgoritmer tilskrives nu evne til præcist at forudsige brist-risiko, adskille mellem forskellige aneurisme-typer, opdage og lokalisere aneurismer samt vurdere deres vækststatus. Kombineringen af deep learning, morfologiske karakteristika og radiomiske features undersøges også for at give avanceret varsling om aorta-dissektion. Disse studier fremhæver potentialet ved algoritmer i at forbedre diagnosen og behandlingen af aneurismer.
